svg.aria-label: Sequence of one UDP session: the client sends UDP ASSOCIATE, socks5 hands off with ErrUDPAssociationRequested, binds the second socket and replies; the handler creates the session and runs relay.Datagrams. Each packet asks the routing cache, which asks the router on a miss; the cached decision is an outbound or a block. Session.Send writes through freedom's NAT; replies come back through the session to the client. Closing the control connection ends the session.
svg.title: One UDP session opened by SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE

g.text: Association: the control TCP connection bounds the whole UDP session
The session also ends after udp_session_idle_timeout (5m) of silence. Inside freedom each NAT socket closes after nat.idle_timeout (5m); a cached route is
forgotten after 1 minute unused. A packet that is blocked, or cannot be routed or sent, is dropped; the session continues. Nothing is sniffed in a UDP session.
14. Decision (cached, a block too; failures are not)
18. from the socket the mapping policy picks
19. reply; the filtering policy may drop it
22. reply with SOCKS5 header, from destination
24. session ends: closes every outbound datagram
